description: Main window: open and save dialogs; reading and writing only the files picked in those dialogs (the dialog plugin adds each picked path to the fs scope). A film is written through a file handle (open, seek, write) and removed when its export does not finish. Offline tile packs and « Mes projets »: files under $APPDATA/tiles and $APPDATA/projects only (mkdir, read_dir, exists added, scope limited to those folders). Native video encoder (system ffmpeg, src/video.rs): its six commands, writing only a file picked in the save dialog. Closing the window: a question (message dialog), then destroy once the last write is done (src/ui/library.ts, installCloseGuard). « Importer depuis Strava »: a one-shot listener on 127.0.0.1 for the redirect (oauth plugin), and the system browser opened on the Strava authorization page only (opener plugin).
